equity_bridge.item: Parent's ~42% attributable share of term deposits (5,105.9m) and structured deposits in other current financial assets (10,844.8m), held largely at listed subsidiaries
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim notes 17 and 18; 0.42 x 15,950.6m. Pledged deposits for bills payable (6,485.9m) excluded as working-capital collateral; FVOCI trade/bills receivables (13,525.5m) excluded as working capital.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: equity 3-yr CAGR 5.7% is the anchor, cut to the FY2026 run-rate (H1 FY2026 revenue +2.0%, Q1 down YoY; sector revenue flat in H1 2026) and the 15th Five-Year-Plan 'steady growth' framing; base path averages 3.0% over years 1-5
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Owner-FCF CAGRs (31.5% / 28.0%) are not a growth signal: FY2025 owner FCF of RMB16.8bn embeds a RMB4.7bn working-capital inflow from payables growing faster than receivables + inventories, and group FCF is ~58% NCI-owned. Revenue vs equity vs EPS CAGRs are within 30% of one another (7.3 / 5.7 / 4.6 over 3 years).
historical_growth.notes: 3-year CAGRs are on the restated RMB series (FY2022-FY2025). 5-year CAGRs convert the FY2020 HKD figures at the 2020 average HKD/CNY of ~0.889 (revenue HK$200,423m -> ~RMB178.2bn; equity HK$46,470m -> ~RMB41.3bn; EPS HK$0.52 -> ~RMB0.46) and carry FX noise of +/-1pp. Owner-FCF series: FY2020 HK$5,493m (6,169 - 0 - 676) -> ~RMB4,883m; FY2022 RMB7,374m (8,195 - 100 - 721); FY2025 RMB16,771m.

scenario_narratives.base: China's pharma market stabilises at low-single-digit growth under the 15th Five-Year Plan; CR Pharma grows ~3% a year with modest mix shift toward manufacturing and DTP retail lifting EBITDA margin to 6.7%. About 62% of operating profit leaks to tax and non-controlling interests, and the wholly-owned distribution business continues to carry the group's RMB77bn of gross debt. The equity is a thin, levered slice of a large, low-margin enterprise: the valuation is far more sensitive to the net-debt bridge and the exit multiple than to growth.
scenario_narratives.bull: Manufacturing re-accelerates, Tasly/blood-products M&A delivers, DTP retail compounds, VBP pricing stabilises; margin reaches 7.5%, leakage eases to 59% as minorities are bought in, and a 16x exit is paid for a top-3 integrated SOE platform.
scenario_narratives.bear: VBP/DRG compression, flat hospital volumes and a weakening OTC consumer push margins back to 5.7%; the payables stretch unwinds and refinancing of the 81% short-dated debt book absorbs cash. With RMB55bn of parent-borne net debt against an attributable enterprise value of similar size, the bear case leaves little or no equity value.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on attributable flows. Group headline numbers (RMB270bn revenue, RMB17bn reported FCF, RMB9.7bn net profit) overstate what accrues to 3320.HK shareholders roughly 2.4-fold: ~58% of profit belongs to NCI holders of the listed subsidiaries, and the gross debt sits with the wholly-owned distribution arm. The model therefore applies a combined tax + NCI leakage to EBIT, charges working capital at 100%, deducts gross debt net of cash, and adds back only the parent's share of the subsidiaries' deposits. Leases are an operating cost (treatment B). The terminal value is capped at 15x attributable FCF (~8x group EV/EBITDA) because a Chinese pharma distributor does not get a Gordon multiple. WACC 6.0% in CNY, built from the actual ~50/50 book capital structure with 2.5% debt, the same across scenarios; risk is carried in a 30% bear weight.
key_risks_to_valuation: Allocation of RMB77bn gross debt and RMB31.6bn cash-like assets between the Company and NCI: each RMB10bn of parent-attributable net debt moves value by ~HK$1.87/share, more than the entire base-to-bull spread on operations
NCI leakage rate: each 1pp on the 62% combined leakage is ~2.6% of attributable NOPAT; the listed subsidiaries' share of group growth is higher than the Company's
Working-capital assumption: the FY2025 RMB4.7bn inflow came from payables growing faster than receivables; a reversal to pro-rata consumption (bear) costs ~RMB1bn a year of FCF

Refinancing: 81% of FY2025 borrowings due within one year at ~2.5%; a 100bp rise in the cost of debt is ~RMB0.6bn a year of attributable cash, and the DCF's unlevered structure does not capture that directly

Terminal cap: the exit multiple (15x attributable FCF) binds in every scenario, so the valuation is a multiple call as much as a DCF; and because the enterprise is ~50-70% funded by 2.5% debt, the WACC (6.0%) is unusually low for this folder and each 1pp on it is worth roughly HK$1.5-2/share
Reporting-currency switch (HKD to RMB in FY2023) contaminates pre-FY2022 comparisons; CNY/HKD moves pass straight through to the HKD per-share value

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 4.22-6.53 HKD. FX: Yahoo CNYHKD=X and HKDCNY=X, same date.
data_sources.financials: 3320.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, RMB millions from FY2022; HKD FY2018-FY2021); H1 FY2026 interim report (balance sheet, cash flow, notes 7, 17, 18, 19, 20, EPS note) for the 30 June 2026 anchors; FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement (lines 6854-6978) and notes 7, 8, 9 for the FY0 calibration.
data_sources.qualitative: 3320.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-22): segment mix, VBP/DRG regulatory exposure, NCI structure, leverage and management-turnover risks, 15th Five-Year-Plan priorities.

inputs.share_count_basis: 6,282,510,461 ordinary shares; basic = diluted per H1 FY2026 interim note (subsidiary restricted-share schemes immaterial). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows; the Company itself has issued no shares and bought back none since FY2020.
inputs.net_debt_note: At 30 June 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim, RMB'000): borrowings 52,930,737 current + 6,461,296 non-current, bonds payable 1,254,418 current + 16,724,264 non-current = 77,370,715 total debt; less cash and cash equivalents 15,622,384. Lease liabilities (386,155 + 731,577) EXCLUDED under lease treatment (B). Pledged bank deposits for bills payable (6,485,930) are collateral for payables and are left out of the bridge. Term deposits (5,105,857) and structured deposits in other current financial assets (10,844,784) are added back in equity_bridge at the parent's attributable share only, because they sit largely in the partly-owned listed manufacturing subsidiaries (CR Sanjiu, Dong-E-E-Jiao, CR Jiangzhong, CR Double-Crane, CR Boya) whereas the gross debt is borne by the wholly-owned distribution business (CR Pharmaceutical Commercial) and the holdco bonds.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement, 'Equity-settled restricted share incentive schemes expense' RMB5,861k (FY2024 78,315k; FY2023 141,891k) -- subsidiary-level schemes only; no equity-award cash taxes disclosed (recorded 0).
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 interest income RMB483,967k is excluded from the component EBITDA (EBITDA = PBT + net finance costs - share of associates) and the cash it is earned on is netted in the bridge, so it is deducted from reported FCF to keep the owner-FCF base consistent with the build even though the group is net-debt.
inputs.last_fcf_note: last_fcf is the GROUP owner FCF (OCF 20,476 - capex 3,216 - SBC 6 - interest income 484). It is flattered by RMB4.7bn of working-capital inflow (payables +10.8bn vs receivables + inventories +6.1bn) and roughly 58% of the underlying profit belongs to non-controlling interests; the component build's attributable year-1 FCF is therefore far below this figure by construction, not by error. Attributable, ex-working-capital equivalent is about RMB5bn.
inputs.buyback_note: No Company-level repurchases FY2021-H1 FY2026 (RMB9.5m in FY2020). Listed subsidiaries repurchased their own shares (RMB80m FY2025, RMB120m H1 FY2026); that is an NCI buy-in, not a Company buyback.
inputs.fx_note: Statements in RMB (reporting currency switched from HKD to RMB from FY2023 with FY2022 comparatives restated; FY2018-FY2021 rows of the Metrics CSV are HKD). Market quote in HKD on HKEX. fx_rate is CNY->HKD = 1.1747 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-22T07:27Z); cross-check HKDCNY=X 0.8504 -> 1/0.8504 = 1.1759, 0.1% apart. Per-share values are computed in CNY and multiplied by fx_rate to the HKD quote basis. No dual listing of 3320.HK exists for a parity check; the A-share-listed subsidiaries are different securities.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-22T07:52:14Z (intraday, 8 minutes before the HKEX close; refresh at the regular close)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency, from the Company's ACTUAL capital structure: cost of equity 9.5% = 10-year CGB ~1.8% + 0.9 beta x ~6.5% China ERP (7.65%) + ~1.85pp single premium for the SOE/minority-governance discount and the refinancing dependency (81% of FY2025 borrowings due within one year); cost of debt 2.5% pre-tax (FY2025 interest paid RMB1,886m on ~RMB74bn average debt), 2.05% after tax; weights ~49% equity / 51% debt at parent book equity 52.8bn vs parent-borne net debt ~55bn (market weights would be ~30/70 and give ~4.3%). 0.49 x 9.5 + 0.51 x 2.05 = 5.7%, rounded UP to 6.0%. A 7% WACC was tried first and rejected: against 2.5% debt it implies an 18% cost of equity on the ~30% equity slice, which charges the debt-funded capital a return its lenders do not demand. The same 6.0% is applied to all three scenarios; risk otherwise lives in the scenario weights (bear 30%), not stacked a second time in per-scenario discount rates.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost. Lease cash (FY2025: principal 728,231k + interest on lease liabilities 59,989k = RMB788m, 0.29% of revenue) is charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path = 0.3%; lease liabilities (RMB1,118m) are excluded from net debt; D&A is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 4,082 - 828 = 3,254m = 1.21% of revenue).
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged ONCE, in the flows. cash_tax_rate_path is a combined cash-tax + NCI leakage rate applied to EBIT, so projected NOPAT and FCF are attributable to Company shareholders. Calibration on FY2025: engine EBIT = EBITDA 17,159 - SBC 6 - lease 788 - D&A ex-ROU 3,254 = 13,111; attributable profit 4,045 + parent-borne after-tax finance cost ex-lease (~85% x 1,967 x 0.82 = 1,371) - parent's 42% share of after-tax interest income (167) - parent's share of associates (110) = 5,139 attributable unlevered NOPAT, i.e. leakage 60.8% on P&L tax (18.2% of PBT) or 62.8% on cash tax paid (23.6% of PBT, FY2025 2,778m vs 2,143m charge). Base uses 62%. NCI is NOT deducted again in the bridge. da_pct is set equal to capex_pct so the 100%-vs-attributable mismatch on the D&A add-back nets to zero. Working capital is charged at 100% because it sits in the wholly-owned distribution business.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component route, with the non-US adaptations (dual currency CNY/HKD, IFRS 16 leases treatment B, large NCI folded into the leakage driver, negative working-capital capture for a distributor). Routed as an operating company: ~79% of revenue is pharma wholesale distribution (5.8% gross margin, ~32% of segment result), ~17% manufacturing (~60% gross margin, ~67% of segment result), ~4.5% retail. EBITDA in the Metrics CSV is post-IFRS-16 and already excludes interest income and share of associates (verified: FY2025 PBT 11,796 + net finance costs 1,543 - associates 262 + D&A 4,082 = 17,159). FY2025 impairment losses of RMB1,552m (mostly receivables) are left inside EBITDA because they recur every year for a distributor. SBC-zero market: FY2025 SBC is RMB5.9m on RMB270bn revenue (0.002%), so the SBC rows are carried explicitly at 0% and house and street coincide; band_position is degenerate and should be read as null. The dominant valuation uncertainty is not growth but the allocation of RMB77bn of gross debt and RMB31.6bn of cash-like assets between the Company and the ~58% NCI; every RMB10bn of parent-attributable net debt is worth about HK$1.87 per share.

bear.narrative: VBP rounds and DRG/DIP payment reform keep compressing distribution gross margin below 5.8% and hospital volumes stay flat; manufacturing's H1 FY2026 decline (-1.5%) proves to be the new trend as OTC demand weakens with the consumer; EBITDA margin slips back to 5.7%. The payables stretch reverses so working capital consumes the full pro-rata 25% of growth, and the Company's share of profit erodes to 36% as the parent-owned distribution arm bears the margin hit. Exit at 12x attributable FCF. Against RMB55bn of parent-borne net debt this path leaves little equity value -- the leverage, not the operations, is the bear axis.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 at the H1 run-rate (+2.0%) rounded to 2.5%, recovering to 3.5% as the China pharma market 'bottoms out' and DTP retail (+19% FY2025) and bolt-on M&A (Tasly, Green Cross HK) annualise; fading to 2.5% terminal in nominal RMB.
base.margin_rationale: FY2025 EBITDA margin 6.37% (FY2021 5.46% -> FY2025 6.37% on manufacturing mix); H1 FY2026 6.80% is seasonally high (H1 FY2025 6.77% vs FY2025 6.37%). Base lets mix shift add ~30bp over the decade, capped at 6.7% because distribution (79% of revenue) is under continuous VBP/DRG price pressure.
base.cash_tax_rate_rationale: Combined cash-tax + NCI leakage, see inputs.nci_treatment. 62% = midpoint of the P&L-tax (60.8%) and cash-tax (62.8%) calibrations to FY2025 attributable profit. Held flat: H1 FY2026 attributable share rose to 43.5% from 41.9%, but manufacturing (where NCI is highest) is the faster-growing segment, so the two effects offset.
base.wc_capture_rationale: Net working capital (receivables 112bn + inventories 45bn - payables 87.7bn - contract liabilities 3.2bn) is ~24% of revenue, so pure pro-rata growth would consume 24% of incremental revenue; the group has historically funded part of this by stretching payables (payables/revenue 31.3% FY2024 -> 31.8% FY2025). -15% assumes that stretch continues to offset roughly a third of the pro-rata requirement.
base.terminal_rationale: Gordon at 6%/2.5% implies ~29x FCF, which no buyer pays for a Chinese pharma distributor; the 15x cap on attributable unlevered FCF binds and corresponds to roughly 8x group EV/EBITDA -- below a segment-result-weighted peer multiple (~67% manufacturing at the 12-15x the A-share market pays CR Sanjiu / Dong-E-E-Jiao, ~33% distribution at Sinopharm / Shanghai Pharma's 5-6x, blended ~10x).

bull.narrative: Manufacturing re-accelerates after the H1 FY2026 dip (OTC/pediatric and anti-infection categories recover, Tasly and blood-products integration delivers), DTP/specialty retail keeps compounding ~20%, and the 11th-round VBP 'anti-involution' rules stabilise generic pricing. Mix shift lifts EBITDA margin to 7.5%; the Company buys in minorities so leakage eases to 59%; payables discipline keeps working capital to a 10% drag. Exit at 17x attributable FCF.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: the Company is a levered minority slice (RMB55bn parent-borne net debt, 81% of borrowings due within a year) of an enterprise whose largest segment is under structural price regulation, management and the CFO turned over in 2025-26, and the debt/cash allocation between parent and NCI -- the dominant input -- is itself uncertain. Bull cut to 20% because it needs manufacturing re-acceleration, margin mix shift, minority buy-ins and a continued payables stretch to all hold at once. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
